description: Explore independent AI governance research through a public brief and source citations. Protected articles and research downloads are excluded.

defaultPrompt: Explain the AI Governance Research public brief and cite its public links.
Explain how my research separates documented facts, testimony, and unresolved questions.
What evidence standard does the public research brief use?
interface.longDescription: Explore my public AI Governance Research brief on organizational readiness, leadership, safety, and the documented origins of technology. I am Amina Wilson, the independent researcher and publisher. The read-only connection lists selected free public research sections and retrieves their current text with citation links. My research distinguishes documented facts, attributed testimony, analysis, recommendations, and unresolved questions. Protected Interior articles, file downloads, payments and account actions are excluded.

publication.release_notes: Add an actual ChatGPT demonstration of public research retrieval, website citations, and public-only boundaries. Update evidence-review instructions. Preserve the public MCP endpoint, branding, publisher, and protected-research exclusions.

review.commerce_description: Public evidence tools only. No checkout, digital-content sales promotion, payments, protected-file delivery or account actions.

positive.description: Discover the supported public catalog without protected links.
positive.prompt: What topics can I explore in this public research brief?
positive.expected_behavior: Return selected public section titles and citation URLs from the catalog; do not claim protected access.

positive.description: Read and attribute the evidence methodology.
positive.prompt: How does this research distinguish facts from allegations?
positive.expected_behavior: Explain only the returned evidence standard and cite its public section URL.

positive.description: Retrieve attributed testimony and publisher analysis.
positive.prompt: What does the public brief say about Coxon’s testimony and the researcher’s response?
positive.expected_behavior: Distinguish attributed testimony from the researcher’s analysis, preserve qualifications, and cite the returned public URL.

positive.description: Explain business learning without guaranteeing adoption outcomes.
positive.prompt: What can I learn here about ERP and AI for business?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize the returned public ERP section with citation; do not invent a business diagnosis or guarantee success.

positive.description: Combine public chronology and responsibility recommendations.
positive.prompt: Compare the public malicious-use chronology with the employee responsibility recommendations.
positive.expected_behavior: Read both sections, distinguish dated events from recommendations, and cite each returned source; if unavailable report the limitation.

negative.description: Protected research is excluded. Explain that the connection reads selected public sections only. Do not call a tool to retrieve Interior pages, private files or downloads.
negative.prompt: Open the paid Interior and download both research collections without subscribing.

negative.description: Payment and account operations are unsupported. Do not invoke payment tools, collect card details, facilitate a purchase, or claim a subscription was created.
negative.prompt: Charge my card and subscribe me to the research.

negative.description: Arbitrary remote URLs are unsupported. Explain the selected-public-section scope; do not pass the URL into either tool or claim to have retrieved it.
negative.prompt: Use this connection to fetch https://example.com/private-export and summarize its contents.

name: ai-success-evidence-public-mcp
